'''Rosh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Voss]], where he was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of [[Fort Kodentha]].
